name: Jarvis - Sales Forecast and Trend Analysis Agent

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{agent:'sales_forecast',status:'skipped',reason:'No sales forecasting or trend-analysis intent was detected.'}}];

parameters.query: DECLARE @n int={{Math.min(12,Math.max(1,Number($json.forecast_months||6)))}}; DECLARE @sub nvarchar(100)=N'{{String($json.product_subcategory||'').replace(/'/g,"''")}}'; WITH s AS (SELECT d.FullDateAlternateKey dt,'Internet' channel,COALESCE(ps.EnglishProductSubcategoryName,'Uncategorized') subcategory,SUM(f.SalesAmount) revenue FROM dbo.FactInternetSales f JOIN dbo.DimDate d ON d.DateKey=f.OrderDateKey JOIN dbo.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey=f.ProductKey LEFT JOIN dbo.DimProductSubcategory ps ON ps.ProductSubcategoryKey=p.ProductSubcategoryKey WHERE @sub='' OR ps.EnglishProductSubcategoryName=@sub GROUP BY d.FullDateAlternateKey,COALESCE(ps.EnglishProductSubcategoryName,'Uncategorized') UNION ALL SELECT d.FullDateAlternateKey,'Reseller',COALESCE(ps.EnglishProductSubcategoryName,'Uncategorized'),SUM(f.SalesAmount) FROM dbo.FactResellerSales f JOIN dbo.DimDate d ON d.DateKey=f.OrderDateKey JOIN dbo.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey=f.ProductKey LEFT JOIN dbo.DimProductSubcategory ps ON ps.ProductSubcategoryKey=p.ProductSubcategoryKey WHERE @sub='' OR ps.EnglishProductSubcategoryName=@sub GROUP BY d.FullDateAlternateKey,COALESCE(ps.EnglishProductSubcategoryName,'Uncategorized')),m AS(SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(dt),MONTH(dt),1) month_start,channel,subcategory,SUM(revenue) revenue FROM s GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(dt),MONTH(dt),1),channel,subcategory),b AS(SELECT MAX(month_start) last_month FROM m),n AS(SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM n WHERE n<12) SELECT CONVERT(char(7),DATEADD(month,n.n,b.last_month),120) forecast_month,m.channel,m.subcategory,CAST(AVG(m.revenue) AS decimal(19,2)) forecast_revenue,'same calendar month average' method,COUNT(*) observations FROM b CROSS JOIN n JOIN m ON MONTH(m.month_start)=MONTH(DATEADD(month,n.n,b.last_month)) WHERE n.n<=@n GROUP BY DATEADD(month,n.n,b.last_month),m.channel,m.subcategory ORDER BY forecast_month,m.channel,m.subcategory OPTION(MAXRECURSION 12);

parameters.jsCode: const analysis=($json.output||[]).flatMap(i=>i.content||[]).find(c=>c.type==='output_text')?.text||'No narrative returned'; const prior=$('Build Forecast Analysis').first().json; return [{json:{agent:'sales_forecast',status:'completed',analysis,data:prior.data}}];
